differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia due to occult gastrointestinal blood loss (e.g., colon cancer)
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 42.5 fL) with reactive thrombocytosis in a 60‑year‑old at risk for GI bleed makes iron deficiency most likely.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic inflammatory conditions (periodontitis, hypertension) can cause normocytic‑to‑microcytic anemia with modest hemoglobin drop.

differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Marked microcytosis with relatively preserved hemoglobin suggests a hereditary hemoglobinopathy common in white populations.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Elderly patient with unexplained cytopenias and elevated platelets may represent early clonal marrow disorder.

differential.name: Early chronic kidney disease‑related anemia
differential.rationale: Slightly elevated creatinine (borderline) could indicate reduced erythropoietin production contributing to anemia.
